note: auto_slice (Slices.lean) gives, for every axis, the same position integral as the sign times toll times the response; applying it at i and j gives the display, and `full` (Switch.lean) uses it for Resp_i = -Resp_j. [L] writes the normalisation as toll multiplying the response instead of (2pi)^{-3} on the position side, and puts the sign on the integral side.

snippet.text:
lemma auto_slice (V : Chamber S i) (H : S.Hierarchy) (A : Weight L) {α} (ha : Own A i α)
    (f : Panels) (hl : Allows i A A (f i)) (hr : Runs (ν V A) i 1 (f i)) :
    Integrable (fun y => readsCluster S A A y * positionTest f y) ∧ Integrable (answer i 1 f) (ν V A) ∧
      signValue α * (∫ y, readsCluster S A A y * positionTest f y)=(toll:ℂ)*∫ p,answer i 1 f p ∂ν V A := by

proof_context.conclusion: For each axis i with sign alpha, signValue alpha · ∫ S(...)·positionTest f = toll · ∫ answer i 1 f dnu_i, with both integrands integrable.

snippet.text:
private lemma full (H : S.Hierarchy) (i j : Axis) (V : Chamber S i) (W : Chamber S j) (A : Weight L) (b c : Bool)
    (hi : Own A i b) (hj : Own A j c) (hbc : b≠c)
    (f : Grouping) (ha : Allows i A A (stamp (f i))) (hb : Allows j A A (stamp (f j))) (hv : Runs (ν V A) i 1 (stamp (f i))) (hw : Runs (ν W A) j 1 (stamp (f j))) :
    pay (ν V A) i Finset.univ (f i) f= -pay (ν W A) j Finset.univ (f j) f := by
  let g : Panels := fun i => stamp (f i)
  have hz (i : Axis) (V : Chamber S i) : (∫ p,answer i 1 g p ∂ν V A)=(pay (ν V A) i Finset.univ (f i) f:ℂ) := by
    unfold pay; rw [← integral_complex_ofReal]
    refine integral_congr_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [before V A] with p hp
    change Lap 1 _ (p i) * _= _
    rw [ofReal_mul, Reel_real _ _ _ hp]; congr 1; exact crop_read ..
  have h₁ := (auto_slice V H A hi g ha hv).2.2; have h₂ := (auto_slice W H A hj g hb hw).2.2
  apply ofReal_injective
  rw [ofReal_neg]
  rw [← hz,← hz]
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ toll_nz
  rw [← h₁,mul_neg,← h₂]
  cases b <;> cases c <;> simp [signValue] at hbc ⊢

proof_context.conclusion: For axes i, j with opposite signs, combines auto_slice for both chambers on the same position integral to get pay_i = -pay_j.
